reason: I already count the drawer myself every night and the register works, so ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month for ever is money going out without new customers coming in. I don't do monthly subscriptions for something I can check with my own eyes.
objection: A monthly fee that never stops, and my girls will feel I'm spying on them with the selfie check-in. If two of them leave over it, the app costs me far more than ₹999.
would_change_my_mind: No monthly fee: one payment of about ₹3,000-4,000 with the setup included, and the selfie check-in made optional so I can switch it off.
